pages.text: There are five Basic Dusts: $(item)Metal Dust$(), $(item)Life Dust$(), $(item)Order Dust$(), $(item)Fire Dust$() and $(item)Earth Dust$().$(br2)The $(item)Hand Vacuum$() recovers only the heavier group: Metal, Order and Earth.

pages.title: Heavier Dusts
pages.text: Metal, Order and Earth Dust can be recovered by either vacuum.
Life and Fire Dust belong to the lighter group. Recovering all five Basic Dusts requires an $(item)Iron Vacuum$() powered by Energized Dust.

pages.title: Lighter Dusts
pages.text: Life and Fire Dust require the Iron Vacuum.
